title: Lennar Breaks Ground on the Residential Homes at Broadcast District, a Walkable Mixed-Use Community in Wyomissing, PA
summary: Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the groundbreaking of Broadcast District, a vibrant new neighborhood bringing 441 townhomes and single-family homes to a mixed-use...
body_markdown:
WYOMISSING, Pa.


, Oct. 8, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the groundbreaking of Broadcast District, a vibrant new neighborhood bringing 441 townhomes and single-family homes to a mixed-use setting that integrates residential living with shopping, dining and recreation.


"Broadcast District brings a new dimension of walkable, connected community life to this part of Berks County," said Tench Tilghman, Division President of Lennar's Pennsylvania-Delaware Division. "With green spaces, everyday essentials, and shared destinations woven directly into the neighborhood, Broadcast District offers something new and distinctive for the area – a place designed to make everyday life more convenient, connected and vibrant."


Developed in partnership with Concordia Group and SJC Ventures, the heart of Broadcast District is a 120,000-square-foot retail center anchored by Whole Foods Market, along with nationally recognized brands such as Sephora and Shake Shack.


Broadcast District's five distinct home collections, inclusive of 8 floorplans ranging from 1,200 to 4,700 square feet, are designed for a variety of lifestyles, from first-time to move-up homebuyers. Sales are anticipated to begin in winter 2026, and tours will be available at six professionally decorated model homes, including five townhomes and one single-family home. Pricing will start in the $300,000s.


Every home offers Lennar's signature[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4792254-1&h=701729103&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4083698-1%26h%3D1485268572%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lennar.com%252Fproductsandservices%252Feverythings-included%26a%3DEverything%2527s%2BIncluded%25C2%25AE&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) program, where the homebuilder's most popular features and finishes are built into the base price of the home. At Broadcast District, this includes stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a host of other carefully curated interior touches and designer fixtures.


Planned onsite amenities provide green spaces, outdoor fitness areas, a dog park, community gathering spaces, and a one-mile walking trail. Routes 422 and 222 are easily accessible, connecting residents to major employers and business hubs. Blue Marsh Lake, Penn State Berks as well as additional shopping, dining, and recreational options, are within close reach. The community is served by the highly rated Wilson School District.


For more information on these new home opportunities, call (484) 960-7259 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4792254-1&h=43530125&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fpennsylvania%2Fgreater-philadelphia-area%2Fpromo%2Fpenlen_broadcastdistrict&a=community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation** Lennar Corporation is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making the American dream of homeownership attainable for more people. Since its founding in 1954, Lennar has built more than 1.5 million homes for buyers at every stage of life in communities across the country, from first-time and move-up buyers to active adults. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes.
